sql: SELECT 'bot_mode_1h' AS metric, COALESCE(string_agg(DISTINCT mode, ','),'(none)') AS value FROM bot_runs WHERE started_at > now() - interval '1 hour' UNION ALL SELECT 'game_matches_total', count(*)::text FROM game_market_matches UNION ALL SELECT 'game_matches_active', count(*)::text FROM game_market_matches WHERE status='active' UNION ALL SELECT 'game_matches_ended', count(*)::text FROM game_market_matches WHERE status='ended' UNION ALL SELECT 'game_tape_total', count(*)::text FROM game_tape_snapshots UNION ALL SELECT 'game_tape_kalshi', count(*)::text FROM game_tape_snapshots WHERE venue='kalshi' UNION ALL SELECT 'game_tape_pm', count(*)::text FROM game_tape_snapshots WHERE venue='polymarket' UNION ALL SELECT 'game_tape_latest', COALESCE(max(traded_at)::text,'(none)') FROM game_tape_snapshots UNION ALL SELECT 'match_sample', COALESCE(string_agg(s.team || '/' || substr(s.kalshi_ticker,10,18) || ' k=' || s.kalshi_trades || ' p=' || s.pm_trades, ' | '),'(none)') FROM (SELECT team, kalshi_ticker, kalshi_trades, pm_trades FROM game_market_matches ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 6) s
